key.name: autostart
key.description: Whether to automatically start PinePal when the user logs in (managed via the XDG Background portal).

key.name: auto-connect-address
key.description: Bluetooth address of the last connected InfiniTime device for automatic reconnection.

key.name: forward-notifications
key.description: Whether to forward desktop notifications to the connected watch.

key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Keep the app running and connected when the window is closed.

key.name: weather-location
key.description: Saved location for weather updates, stored as "name|latitude|longitude".
